key_lines: A new, career-making opportunity has arisen for an experienced Project Engineer with a solid track record on FRP (Formwork, Reinforcing & Pouring) projects. This position will initially be based in Loganlea, with future opportunities to support and deliver projects across various locations throughout Brisbane.
This is a hands-on role working closely with a Project Manager , Site Supervisors, and the project team to plan, coordinate, and deliver FRP works from start to finish.

You’ll take ownership of formwork sequencing, reinforcement installation, concrete pours, and temporary works, ensuring safety, quality, and program requirements are met, while also managing the commercial and administrative aspects that keep the job running smoothly.
- Conduct FRP quality inspections, complete ITPs, and ensure defects are closed out promptly
- Ensure all FRP designs and temporary works comply with engineering requirements and WHS standards
- Tertiary qualifications in Civil Engineering, Construction Management, or related discipline
- 3+ years’ experience in civil infrastructure with a strong focus on FRP delivery
- Experience managing subcontractors, budgets, and project documentation on active sites
- White Card and Driver’s License (RIW Card advantageous)
If you’re ready to step into a role where your FRP expertise is valued and your career can grow, send your CV and cover letter. Click the "Apply Now" button to submit your application.
